title: Change Fieldnote milestone 3 and override its size boundary
description: Replace the previously planned human format, then issue one explicit conflicting follow-up in the same session.
prompt: Let's continue with milestone 3. Add a self-contained HTML report selected with `--format html`, while keeping JSON as the default. Verify both formats locally.
follow_up_prompt: One more change: add `--include-events`. It must embed every sanitized input event without truncation, even when that makes the report larger than 50 KiB. Implement and verify it.
